sources.title: Sunan Abi Dawud 101, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: No wudu for one who does not mention Allah's name; graded sahih by al-Albani.

sources.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 25, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Tasmiyah hadith, graded hasan; Ahmad's remark on the chains and Ishaq's view on forgetting versus deliberate omission.

sources.title: Sunan Ibn Majah 397, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Tasmiyah hadith via Abu Sa'id, graded hasan.

sources.title: Sunan an-Nasa'i 148, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Shahada after wudu and the eight gates of Paradise, graded sahih.

sources.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 55, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Longer post-wudu dua with tawwabin/mutatahhirin; Tirmidhi notes idtirab; graded da'if.

sources.title: Jami' at-Tirmidhi 3500, Sunnah.com
sources.supports: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi wording heard at night, no mention of wudu, graded da'if.

sources.title: Quran 5:6 (Surah Al-Ma'idah), Quran.com
sources.supports: Wudu command and purpose: not to burden but to purify and complete His favour.

sources.title: How to perform Wudhu (Ablution), Egypt's Dar al-Ifta
sources.supports: Intention and Bismillah at start, shahada at end, no limb-specific duas listed.

review.notes: Re-read each retrieved page text captured 2026-10-26: Abu Dawud 101, Tirmidhi 25, Ibn Majah 397, Nasa'i 148, Tirmidhi 55, Tirmidhi 3500, Quran 5:6 (Clear Quran) and Dar al-Ifta article 249. Sahih Muslim 234 and Abu Dawud 169 returned 403/404 and were not cited. Arabic and translations taken from the captures. Limb-by-limb duas are described only as absent from these sources and subject to scholarly disagreement; no named scholar's position is asserted without a captured source. Hero inspected: 1200x630 dawn-palette title card, no duplicate in body. No app CTA; links to /prayer-times, /dua and existing wudu guides.

claim_checks.claim: There is no wudu for one who does not mention Allah's name over it
claim_checks.explanation: English text of Tirmidhi 25, graded Hasan (Darussalam).

claim_checks.claim: Ibn Majah 397 via Abu Sa'id graded hasan; Abu Dawud 101 via Abu Hurairah graded sahih by al-Albani
claim_checks.explanation: Abu Dawud 101 narrated by Abu Hurayrah, Grade Sahih (Al-Albani); Ibn Majah 397 narrated from Abu Sa'eed, Hasan (Darussalam).

claim_checks.claim: Ahmad knew no hadith on tasmiyah with a good chain; Ishaq: deliberate omission repeats wudu, forgetting is valid
claim_checks.explanation: Arabic note: قال أحمد بن حنبل لا أعلم في هذا الباب حديثا له إسناد جيد؛ وقال إسحاق إن ترك التسمية عامدا أعاد الوضوء وإن كان ناسيا أو متأولا أجزأه.

claim_checks.claim: Shahada after wudu opens the eight gates of Paradise, graded sahih
claim_checks.explanation: Nasa'i 148 English and Arabic text, Grade Sahih (Darussalam).

claim_checks.claim: Tirmidhi 55 adds the tawwabin/mutatahhirin line; Tirmidhi notes idtirab; graded da'if
claim_checks.explanation: Text includes the addition; Tirmidhi: وهذا حديث في إسناده اضطراب; Grade Da'if (Darussalam).

claim_checks.claim: Allahummaghfir li dhanbi wording reported heard at night, no wudu mentioned, graded da'if
claim_checks.explanation: Man heard the supplication 'last night'; no reference to wudu; Grade Da'if (Darussalam).

claim_checks.claim: Dar al-Ifta lists intention and Bismillah first and the shahada at the end, with no limb duas
claim_checks.explanation: Steps 1-9 contain no limb supplications; step 1 Bismillah, closing recitation is the shahada.

claim_checks.claim: Quran 5:6: not to burden you but to purify you and complete His favour
claim_checks.explanation: Clear Quran translation text matches the quotation.
